newsitem.title: USA: New York City subway derails in Harlem.
newsitem.headline: New York City subway derails in Harlem.

text.p: A subway train derailed in upper Manhattan Thursday night, police and fire officials said.
An Emergency Medical Services spokesman said there were no fatalities, but that they could not immediately give an assessment of the seriousness or number of injuries.
A police department spokesman said the last three cars of the A train derailed at 10:15 p.m. near St. Nicholas Ave. and West 135th St. in Harlem.
Two subway lines were shut down after the accident.
